result.summary: A stuck loading spinner is overlaying the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, obscuring its content and indicating a loading state handling issue.

issues.description: A loading spinner is rendered on top of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar restaurant card image in the 'Popular right now' section, blocking part of the food image and appearing stuck instead of being hidden after content loads.
issues.suggestion: Implement proper loading state logic to remove the spinner once the card content is fully loaded, or reposition the spinner to not overlay the main content area during loading.
